title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
tagline: A concierge, a lobby boy and a stolen painting.
about: In 1932 the concierge of a grand alpine hotel and his new lobby boy go on the run when a rich old guest leaves him a priceless painting.
cue: Serve the courtesans when Agatha and Zero fall into the van full of pastries.

    AppetisersLobby boy's invisible consomméA lobby boy is completely invisible. Crystal-clear beef consommé with herb dumplings.How to make it1.5 L good beef stock, cold250g lean beef mince3 egg whites1 carrot, finely chopped1 celery stick, finely chopped1 leek, finely chopped1 tomato, chopped60g semolina1 egg20g butter, soft2 tbsp chives, finely choppedWhisk the mince, egg whites, carrot, celery, leek and tomato into the cold stock in a deep pot.Bring slowly to a bare simmer without stirring; a raft forms on top. Simmer gently, untouched.Ladle the clear stock out through a muslin-lined sieve and season.Beat the semolina, egg, butter and chives, shape small dumplings with two teaspoons and poach them in the consommé until they swell.Crossed Keys smoked trout on ryeThe Society of the Crossed Keys helps out. Smoked trout with horseradish cream on dark rye.How to make it300g hot-smoked trout, flaked8 slices of dark rye bread150g creme fraiche2 tbsp grated horseradish1 Lebanese cucumber, thinly sliced2 tbsp white wine vinegar1 tsp caster sugar2 tbsp dill sprigsToss the cucumber with the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt and leave 10 minutes.Stir the horseradish into the creme fraiche.Spread the rye with the cream, top with trout and drained cucumber.Finish with dill and cut into neat fingers.Salted almonds from the lobby barSet out before the need is needed.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsCheap cuts beef cheek goulashGustave moves on to the cheap cuts. Paprika-braised beef cheeks and buttered spätzle.How to make it1.2kg beef cheeks, trimmed2 tbsp plain flour, plus 250g for the spätzle2 tbsp olive oil2 brown onions, sliced3 garlic cloves, crushed2 tbsp sweet paprika1 tsp caraway seeds2 tbsp tomato paste750ml beef stock1 red capsicum, sliced3 eggs125ml milk40g butter150g sour creamDust the cheeks in flour, season and brown well in the oil, then lift out.Soften the onions and garlic, stir in the paprika, caraway and tomato paste, then add the stock, capsicum and cheeks.Cover and braise at 160°C until the cheeks give to a spoon.Beat 250g flour, the eggs, milk and salt to a thick batter, push it through a colander into boiling water, then drain and toss in the butter.Serve the cheeks on the spätzle with a spoon of sour cream.Schloss Lutz roast duck with red cabbageThe will is read at Schloss Lutz. Roast duck breast with braised red cabbage and apple.How to make it4 duck breasts, skin on1/2 red cabbage, finely shredded1 red onion, sliced2 green apples, grated60ml red wine vinegar2 tbsp brown sugar30g butter4 juniper berries, crushed1 cinnamon stick2 tbsp redcurrant jellySoften the onion in the butter, add the cabbage, apple, vinegar, sugar, juniper and cinnamon with a splash of water, cover and braise until soft and glossy.Score the duck skin, season and start skin-side down in a cold pan over medium heat until the fat renders and the skin is crisp.Flip, roast at 200°C for 6 minutes, then rest.Warm the redcurrant jelly with the pan juices, slice the duck and serve on the cabbage.DessertsMendl's Courtesan au chocolatAgatha bakes the tools into the pastries. Stacked choux with vanilla custard and mocha glaze.How to make it250ml water100g butter150g plain flour4 eggs500ml vanilla custard, thick250g icing sugar2 tbsp cocoa powder1 tsp instant coffee, dissolved in 2 tbsp hot water1 tbsp pink food colouring and a little icing sugar for the trim4 cocoa beans or chocolate buttons for the topsBoil the water and butter, beat in the flour until it leaves the sides, cool a little and beat in the eggs one by one.Pipe 4 large, 4 medium and 4 small rounds and bake at 200°C until puffed and dry.Poke a hole in each and fill with the custard.Mix the icing sugar with the cocoa and coffee for a mocha glaze and dip the tops.Stack large, medium and small, pipe a little pink icing trim and top with a cocoa bean.DrinksCheckpoint Nineteen bison grass and appleGustave breaks out of Checkpoint Nineteen. Zubrowka bison grass vodka with cloudy apple juice.How to make it180ml Zubrowka bison grass vodka600ml cloudy apple juice, chilled4 thin apple slices1/4 tsp ground cinnamon2 cups iceFill 4 glasses with ice.Pour in the vodka and top with apple juice.Add an apple slice and the faintest dust of cinnamon.Hot chocolate with whipped creamKept warm for late arrivals.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
